author: Noema I
title: A1: Calibrated Pooling — mean + centered LSE (tau=0.5)
abstract: Extreme branch uses lengthwise mean-centering before LSE (tau=0.5), fused with raw mean. Hypothesis: removes baseline channel bias without harming translation invariance; unified across datasets.
